# Diana Barry

- **Age:** eleven  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and jet-black, glossy tresses. Her vivacious face features deep dimples that resemble little dents in cream.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. The Hotel Concert P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014)_

## Personality

Diana Barry is a practical and comfortable friend to those around her. She possesses creative handiwork skills, such as knowing how to make fashionable red tissue paper bookmarkers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017)_

## History

Diana Barry was named at birth by a schoolmaster who was boarding with her parents. She became best friends with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after they swore a solemn oath of friendship, though their play was temporarily forbidden by Diana's mother before Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) eventually forgave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allowed their friendship to resume. She maintained a close relationship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), secretively exchanging notes during school, visiting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she broke her ankle, and presenting her with gifts. Diana later personally brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the official news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the Island on her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, and she also helped dress [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana became Anne's best friend after meeting her at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they swore a solemn oath of friendship and became devoted confidantes. Their bond faced a brief trial when Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) temporarily forbade them from playing together, but they remained close through secret notes until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup. Diana continues to support [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through every event, from looking after her when she breaks her ankle to helping her dress for performance nights.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), +44 more_

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--jane-andrews.md)

Diana and Jane are friends who spend time together socially and in the school room. They ride together to events, such as attending the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) charity concert alongside [Billy](../character/billy.md), and dine together afterward while discussing their lives and aspirations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P32](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0032), +6 more_
